children: Freemelt called an extraordinary general meeting for 20 November 2026 to seek approval for a rights issue of up to 151.8M shares. It also seeks authorization to issue shares to guarantors as compensation.
Rights issue of up to 151.8M shares proposed
The proposed issue is substantial relative to the 227.7M shares outstanding; approval and final terms remain pending.
Shareholders will vote on the proposed rights issue; the notice provides no subscription price or proceeds amount.
The board seeks authority to issue shares without preferential rights, capped at the number corresponding to agreed guarantee compensation.

This is a financing proposal, not a completed share issue; the notice does not provide the subscription price or expected proceeds. The next catalyst is the EGM vote and subsequent disclosure of the rights issue's final terms.
